description.value: The ORL Lake Country Branch is a public library in Lake Country, BC, part of the Okanagan Regional Library's 30-branch network serving over 399,000 people across the Okanagan and Shuswap regions. The branch offers meeting and study rooms, community programming, and free on-site parking with additional overflow parking at nearby Swalwell Park. Membership is free to residents, and the branch is a walkable community hub in the heart of Lake Country.
